items.issue: The alleged 80-percent arrest rate in Japan and Korea lacks offense definition, denominator, period and source.
items.disposition: Do not state or use the number until official jurisdiction-specific data verifies it.

items.issue: The upload generalizes from a selected accusation case to East Asian legal systems and alleges deliberate wrongful punishment of men.
items.disposition: Require the case record, disposition, statutes and comparative legal evidence; otherwise keep do_not_generalize.

items.issue: Marriage and monogamy are assigned a single deliberate purpose of controlling lower-status men.
items.disposition: Treat as Mikey's ideological interpretation, not established historical intent.

items.issue: References to historical Chinese ritual and criminal law are not accompanied by quoted primary text, dating or scholarly context.
items.disposition: Verify each quotation and legal claim against primary text and specialist scholarship before any factual use.

items.issue: The prostitution-policy explanation asserts sexual scarcity as the main purpose and omits major legal and welfare rationales.
items.disposition: Do not use as policy explanation without jurisdiction-specific evidence and competing explanations.

items.issue: References to Germany and other jurisdictions are incomplete and may conflate legality, regulation, enforcement and outcomes.
items.disposition: Verify current law and empirical outcomes separately for each jurisdiction before mention.

items.issue: The source treats family, school, employment and Confucian teachings as coordinated tools of psychological control.
items.disposition: Separate observable approval pressures from claims of coordinated intent.

items.issue: Women are generalized as enforcing elite control through sexual expectations and standards.
items.disposition: Keep do_not_generalize and never use it to infer an individual woman's motives.

items.issue: The economic claim that society needs insecure men to generate GDP is presented without empirical model or documentary evidence.
items.disposition: Retain only as rhetoric pending economic and institutional evidence.

items.issue: The argument repeatedly infers deliberate system design from outcomes that could have multiple historical and institutional causes.
items.disposition: Independent review must distinguish evidence of effect, mechanism and intent.

items.issue: ASR may corrupt named cases, classical texts, legal terms and country references.
items.disposition: Check original audio and external sources before quoting or naming any case, statute or text.
